title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 97
paragraphs: The commanders of the naval force were these: Ariabignes son of Darius, Prexaspes son of Aspathines, Megabazus son of Megabates, and Achaemenes son of Darius. That is, the Ionian and Carian contingent was commanded by Ariabignes, son of Darius and of the daughter of Gobryas; the Egyptians by Achaemenes, full brother of Xerxes; and the rest of the armament by the other two. In all, the thirty-oared and fifty-oared galleys, the light craft, and the long horse-transport vessels had been gathered together, as it turned out, to a total of three thousand.
